summary: First-finish smoke test of ShopDocs air-gapped DMS. Backend smoke (login, equipment CRUD, PDF upload, by-qr, qr.png, users, audit-logs, role enforcement) all passed against public URL. Frontend end-to-end flows verified via Playwright: admin login, equipment creation, dashboard search + detail navigation, PDF upload + Manuals tab listing, in-browser PDF preview iframe, QR dialog with image + Download PNG button, /qr/:code URL resolution, /scan manual code entry, admin user creation, audit log display, and viewer RBAC (no upload/edit buttons + /admin/* redirects to /). Editor RBAC verified via backend (403 on /api/users and /api/audit-logs).
passed: Frontend: admin login -> dashboard with data-testid='dashboard-search'
Frontend: AdminEquipmentList New Equipment form submits and item appears
Frontend: Dashboard search filters and equipment-card click opens detail
Frontend: Upload Doc dialog uploads PDF; doc-preview-<id> appears under Manuals tab
Frontend: show-qr-btn opens QR dialog with qr-image and qr-download-btn
Frontend: /scan manual code submit navigates to detail page
Frontend: AdminUsers create viewer + audit log page shows recorded actions
Frontend: Viewer RBAC - no upload-doc-btn/edit-equipment-btn, /admin/users redirects to /
minor_observations: Several Radix DialogContent warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' (accessibility nit, non-blocking).
First Playwright run of QR dialog hit a stale preview-iframe intercept; passed cleanly on retest from a fresh detail page.
